title: One-permanent-opening method.
officialText:
One permanent opening, commencing within 12 inches (305 mm) of the top of the
enclosure, shall be provided. The appliance shall have clearances of at least 1 inch (25 mm) from the sides and back and 6 inches (152
mm) from the front of the appliance. The opening shall directly communicate with the outdoors or through a vertical or horizontal duct
to the outdoors or spaces that freely communicate with the outdoors (see Figure 3 04.6.2) and shall have a minimum free area of 1
square inch per 3,000 Btu/h (734 mm2/kW) of the total input rating of all appliances located in the enclosure, and not less than the sum
of the areas of all vent connectors in the space.
